WITH black_friday_orders AS (
    SELECT o.orderid, o.orderdate, o.customerid, c.buyinggroupid
    FROM sales.orders o
    JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customerid = o.customerid
    WHERE o.orderdate = '2024-11-29'
),
order_values AS (
    SELECT bfo.orderid,
           SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
    FROM black_friday_orders bfo
    JOIN sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = bfo.orderid
    GROUP BY bfo.orderid
),
order_promotions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bfo.orderid,
           TRUE AS has_promotion
    FROM black_friday_orders bfo
    JOIN sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = bfo.orderid
    JOIN sales.specialdeals sd ON sd.buyinggroupid = bfo.buyinggroupid
        AND sd.startdate <= bfo.orderdate
        AND sd.enddate >= bfo.orderdate
    JOIN warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sisg ON sisg.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
        AND sisg.stockgroupid = sd.stockgroupid
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN op.has_promotion THEN 'With Promotion' ELSE 'Without Promotion' END AS promotion_status,
    CAST(AVG(ov.order_value) AS NUMERIC) AS average_order_value
FROM order_values ov
LEFT JOIN order_promotions op ON op.orderid = ov.orderid
GROUP BY CASE WHEN op.has_promotion THEN 'With Promotion' ELSE 'Without Promotion' END
